concept.hr: I i Q nositelji pomaknuti za 90° zbrajaju se u jedan titraj amplitude A i faze φ
concept.en: I and Q carriers 90° apart add up to one wave of amplitude A and phase φ

summary.hr: Klizači I i Q težine dva nositelja pomaknuta za 90°; zbroj je titraj s A = √(I² + Q²) i φ = atan2(Q, I), a (I, Q) je točka konstelacijskog dijagrama.
summary.en: Sliders I and Q weight two carriers 90° apart; the sum is a wave with A = √(I² + Q²) and φ = atan2(Q, I), and (I, Q) is a point in the constellation diagram.

what.hr: Aplet applet_iq.html (klizači I i Q, zbroj, konstelacijski dijagram) i tekst o I/Q modulatoru i I/Q prikazu (50ohm.de, odjeljci qam i iq_verfahren)
what.en: The applet applet_iq.html (the I and Q sliders, the sum, the constellation diagram) and the text on the I/Q modulator and the I/Q representation (50ohm.de, sections qam and iq_verfahren)

changes.hr: Prilagođen simdeck kitu i nacrtan kao SVG umjesto Chart.js, preveden na engleski, dodane strelica i kut φ u dijagramu, oznake vrhova i predlošci
changes.en: Adapted to the simdeck kit and drawn as SVG instead of Chart.js, translated into English, an arrow and the angle φ in the diagram, peak marks and presets added
